description: Guarantee the CREATE-on-main route leaves the worktree coherent with HEAD (new issue file present, git-clean), closing the syncWorktreeIfOnMain absent-path invariant for CREATE.

userStories.title: Close the CREATE-on-main worktree-coherence invariant for absent paths
userStories.description: As a cam operator filing a new issue while checked out on main, I need createLocalIssueOnMain's CREATE route to leave the newly-created issue file present and git-clean, so the worktree never shows a spurious deletion-staged entry (the 2026-06-29 'D scripts/cam/issues/CAM-0139.json' footgun).
acceptanceCriteria: On the CREATE route, createLocalIssueOnMain (via writeIssueFile) leaves the worktree coherent with HEAD when on main: after the call git status --porcelain is empty and the newly-created issue file is present in the worktree (not deletion-staged). [oracle: bun test test/integration/write-issue-file-worktree-sync.test.ts]

The created file's path is propagated into syncWorktreeIfOnMain on the CREATE route (the sync runs with the new file's path). [oracle: grep -q 'syncWorktreeIfOnMain(cwd, \[filename\], spawnFn)' src/issues/alloc.ts]

syncWorktreeIfOnMain materializes a path that is absent from the worktree (not only staged-restoring a path already present): a direct real-git test seeds a file into HEAD, removes it from index+worktree, calls syncWorktreeIfOnMain(cwd, [path], spawnFn) on main, then asserts the file is present in the worktree and git status --porcelain is empty; the same test asserts an off-main call leaves the worktree untouched. [oracle: bun test test/integration/sync-worktree-on-main.test.ts]

Scope stays limited to the CREATE route on main: the MODIFY route (commitTreeToMain, CAM-137) and off-main ref-only writes (CAM-133) are unchanged; no second redundant syncWorktreeIfOnMain call is added (no double-restore). [oracle: reviewer-judgment on git diff scope]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Lint/static spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Files: src/git/on-main.ts (syncWorktreeIfOnMain, lines 243-269), src/issues/alloc.ts (writeIssueFile CREATE route, sync call at line 199), src/commands/issue-file.ts (createLocalIssueOnMain call-site, lines 271-318). PRIOR ART: CAM-142 (fix b2f59721, PR #106) already added `syncWorktreeIfOnMain(cwd, [filename], spawnFn)` inside writeIssueFile's `if (result.success)` block, and shipped the real-git regression at test/integration/write-issue-file-worktree-sync.test.ts (CREATE-on-main -> git status --porcelain empty). CAM-137 shipped test/integration/sync-worktree-on-main.test.ts covering ADD/MODIFY/DELETE via commitTreeToMain. The remaining open piece of CAM-140 is AC3 at the FUNCTION level: a DIRECT syncWorktreeIfOnMain absent-path regression (today the absent-path materialization is only proven transitively via commitTreeToMain's ADD case and via writeIssueFile). Add that direct case to sync-worktree-on-main.test.ts (or a sibling), do NOT re-open writeIssueFile's already-correct sync. GOTCHAS: syncWorktreeIfOnMain self-detects the branch via `git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD`, so real-git test repos MUST run `git symbolic-ref HEAD refs/heads/main` (see makeTmpRepo helpers in the existing tests). `git restore --staged --worktree --source=HEAD -- <path>` handles absent paths (restores index+worktree from HEAD). Real-git tests use the gitAvailable + test.skipIf skip guard. Grep patterns.md for 'File-per-issue hygiene' and 'on-main' before coding. Do NOT hand-edit scripts/cam/issues/ during a live cam run session (concurrent writer).
